correctness.rationale: The invariant Laplace perpetuity follows by exponential Brownian sampling and regeneration; uniqueness from synchronous-reset contraction. Each Bernoulli/Laplace factor has exactly the ratio of stationary factors and its variance telescopes, ensuring convergence. The elementary logarithmic Fourier integral yields an explicitly positive and integrable Lévy density difference. Kolmogorov consistency yields a centered independent-increment martingale in c. Symmetric log-concavity of Laplace convolutions, plus unbounded nontrivial independent noise, gives strict symmetric-interval ordering for every threshold. Jensen yields convex order. Exact rational algebra and numerical integral checks are in checker.py. No finite sample is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural control parameter c interpolates between full and weak restarting, and prior research quantified variance and limiting shapes without a full order. The new positive Lévy increment kernel provides an exact independent-noise comparison of the ENTIRE stationary laws for any two c, strict exceedance monotonicity at every physical threshold, and a single independent-increment martingale containing the entire family. This is structural transport and model calibration information beyond a moment formula, finite count or routine numerical re-expression. The proof identifies the special Laplace self-decomposability mechanism rather than extrapolating variance.
